summary: You delivered a solid coral reef monitoring SSO mission with clear rationale, single-sat justification, STK analysis and Australian-focused ground segment and EOL plan. Introduction and mission design are strong. Orbital mechanics descriptions and report presentation need attention to reach full Accomplished.
next_steps: In Orbit section, correct COE definitions: for circular SSO state e=0 so argument of perigee and true anomaly undefined - use mean anomaly, not Argument of Latitude; derive RAAN from LTAN rather than launch site latitude 27.33°.
In Launch, revise equatorial benefit claim: Vega-C/E from Kourou for retrograde SSO does not gain max rotational benefit and needs a dogleg; justify via polar performance and rideshare availability.

In Report presentation, add numbered titles and in-text references for all figures/tables, and replace Wikipedia Timeline and NOAA blogs with manufacturer user manuals, launch provider data and peer-reviewed sources using consistent citation style.

criteria.C1: You covered all four prompts well in Introduction - coral fluid-lensing mission for bleaching, single-sat cost and revisit rationale, and users CSIRO/BOM. To strengthen within Accomplished, add more specific detail on operator control and deepen literature references for bleaching drivers.
criteria.C2: You showed high understanding with STK orbit views, ground tracks, access table contact durations, SSO inclination vs altitude plot and COE table, plus Vega E from Guiana rationale. To reach top of Accomplished, fix the Argument of Latitude and RAAN explanation and correct the equatorial SSO benefit argument.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion recaps launch, polar SSO illumination, ground station and mission benefit. To move to Accomplished, avoid generic recap and provide a quantitative synthesis of your evidence, e.g., revisit, contact time, mission duration, and explicitly link limitations like Vega E readiness to design margins.
criteria.C4: You used a clear engineering structure with Executive Summary and sections and generally correct grammar. To reach Accomplished, label every figure/table with number, title and source and reference it in text, remove unlabelled Image 1, and replace prohibited Wikipedia sources with credible engineering sources.
